gloss: one-shot story; complete story; stand-alone work

definitions.gloss: one-shot story; complete story; stand-alone work
definitions.explanation: a self-contained story that is complete in one installment, not serialized; commonly used for manga one-shots published in magazines

examples.japanese: {今週号|こんしゅうごう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{読|よ}み{切|き}りマンガ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}→掲載：08993_keisai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This week's issue features a one-shot manga.

examples.japanese: {読|よ}み{切|き}り⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{連載|れんさい}→連載：14320_rensai⟧になった⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many works started as one-shots before becoming serialized.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{読|よ}み{切|き}りな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{一晩|ひとばん}→一晩：08887_hitoban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{読|よ}める→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: This novel is a standalone work, so you can finish it in one night.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read) + ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to finish completely) → something that can be read to completion in one sitting

MANGA CONTEXT:
In manga publishing, {読|よ}み{切|き}り refers to:
- A self-contained story (not serialized)
- Often used to test new concepts or artists
- May lead to serialization (⟦{連載|れんさい}→連載：14320_rensai⟧) if popular
- Published in manga magazines alongside serial chapters

USAGE:
- マンガ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読|よ}み{切|き}り (one-shot manga)
- ⟦{短編小説|たんぺんしょうせつ}→短編小説：20776_tanpenshousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読|よ}み{切|き}り (complete short story)
- {読|よ}み{切|き}り⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧ (stand-alone work)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{連載|れんさい}→連載：14320_rensai⟧ (serialization - ongoing story in installments)
- ⟦{長編|ちょうへん}→長編：14475_chouhen⟧ (long-form work)

PUBLISHING PATH:
{読|よ}み{切|き}り → (if successful) → ⟦{連載|れんさい}→連載：14320_rensai⟧ → (if successful) → ⟦{単行本|たんこうぼん}→単行本：11937_tankoubon⟧ (collected volume)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{連載|れんさい}→連載：14320_rensai⟧ (serialization - antonym)
- ⟦{短編|たんぺん}→短編：04512_tanpen⟧ (short story)
- ⟦{完結|かんけつ}→完結：12279_kanketsu⟧ (completion)
- ワンショット (one-shot - English loanword)
